history.notes: Pet page: a back button to your pets list is always there, even with one pet. Plus the urge strength slider with feedback and evenly sized pet cards in list view.

Streaks: a flame shows how many days in a row on each pet. The sky is back with time of day and seasons. A clearer health bar, more breathing room, and the check-in card keeps its shape after you log.
Menus open reliably, the 28-day trail and milestones fit small phones, clearer settings rows, and bigger tap targets.
Your pet cards line up neatly in grid and list view, the add button now sits in the header, and the app stays in portrait.
Cleaner look: small headings now use the same clear font across the app, and your pet cards line up neatly in both grid and list view.
Your pet's room now follows its health, dark and grim when unwell and bright when thriving, plus time of day and a little for each season. You can turn the sky off in Me, Appearance.
